photos.title: File:2019-12-08 Allee in der Georgstraße von Hannover.jpg
photos.author: Bernd Schwabe in Hannover
photos.shows: Street-level axis toward Steintor: two ranks of deciduous trees, red brick side strips, gray center paving, paired concrete entry posts, shop glazing, varied commercial facades.
photos.does_not_show: Does not show full Steintor terminus or roof footprints; winter foliage; 2019 storefront names may differ today.
photos.date_warning: Capture date is historical, not current 2026 survey.

photos.title: File:Grosse Packhofstrasse 18 20 HannoverbGildehaus Schmorl & von Seefeld Hugendubel.jpg
photos.author: Bernd Schwabe in Hannover
photos.shows: Actual Hugendubel/Schmorl & von Seefeld side on Grosse Packhofstrasse: dark tiled vertical sign pier, glass curtain wall, scalloped upper parapet.
photos.does_not_show: Not the rounded Bahnhofstrasse/Georgstrasse corner; narrow supplementary view. 2024 photo.
photos.date_warning: Capture date is historical, not current 2026 survey.

photos.title: File:Kroepcke Center department store Kroepcke square Hanover Germany 01.jpg
photos.author: ChristianSchd
photos.shows: Kroepcke-Center angular rounded prow: pale stone vertical bays, upper recessed windows, double-height corner arcade and long stepped retail facade.
photos.does_not_show: Different building from Magis/Hugendubel corner; 2014 evening lighting affects colors.
photos.date_warning: Capture date is historical, not current 2026 survey.

photos.title: File:Magis department store Hanover Germany 02.jpg
photos.author: ChristianSchd
photos.shows: Rounded Bahnhofstrasse/Georgstrasse corner seen from Kroepcke: continuous horizontal window ribbons, cream cladding bands, curved roofline, tall narrow glazed stair tower on right return.
photos.does_not_show: Storefront reads H&M in this 2014 image; do not treat signs as current. Does not establish Bahnhofstrasse far-end facades or hidden side.
